text:
derek: Heads up -- southamerica-1 private region started evicting GPU nodes after the L7 proxy audit sampling was flipped on during the compliance cutover at 02:45.
elena: Noticed repeated healthcheck 503s from the mixer proxy, kubelet marks node NotReady and drain starts.
frank: Packet/log snippet (redacted):
```
[2026-03-21T02:46:01Z] proxy: request_id=abc123 src=10.4.2.9 dst=keystore-proxy.sa-east-1 svc=healthcheck path=/health 503 "audit-sampled"
[2026-03-21T02:46:01Z] kubelet: node "gpu-node-17" status -> NotReady (health probe failed)
```
elena: The new audit sampler is tagging a subset of healthcheck traffic for deep inspection, but the L7 policy denies sampled flows rather than mirror them. Ops bot shows increased 5xx on /health endpoints.
sre-lead: @compliance we need confirmation: was the intention to block sampled flows or mirror them to SIEM? Blocking health checks breaks node lifecycle.
compliance: The rollout intended to mirror. Looks like the default action was set to DENY by the proxy rule generator for sa-east-1. That's a bad diff. I'm reverting the rule generator for that region now.
derek: Revert timeline? This is scaling down the GPU pool by ~40% in the region; autoscaler is compensating by launching in us-east-1 -> egress/cold start cost delta.
frank: Cost flag: extrapolating current churn it's ~2.5k/hr in extra cross-region prewarm + egress. PG/finance alerted.
ops-bot: Auto-rollback initiated for proxy config in sa-east-1. Deploy ID: deploy-20260321-1832. Will post status updates.
frank: While we wait, suggestion: add a short-lived firewall exception to allow /health from our k8s node cidr to the L7 proxy port 8443. Less blast radius than full revert.
sre-lead: Good plan. Also, run a 100-node canary to confirm the revert fixes boot/health issues: `kubectl apply -f canary-gpu.yaml && kubectl -n infra rollout status ds/gpu-init -w`.
elena: I'll tail the proxy logs and health endpoints after rollback. If we still see sampled drops, we'll need to patch the proxy config to mirror instead of deny for header X-Audit-Sampled.
compliance: Patch incoming. I will post the rule diff to PR: https://git.internal/rules/sa-east-1/audit-mirror PR#789.
derek: Packet captures are uploaded: s3://redwood-debug/sa-east-1/3362223333-health-evict.pcap
ops-bot: rollback complete at 02:53 UTC. Metrics: node ready percentage climbed from 58% -> 92% over 4 minutes.
frank: Nice. Keep monitoring for 30m. I'll pause cross-region prewarms and notify cost team.
sre-lead: After 30m stable, we'll coordinate a safe re-roll with mirror semantics and an automated integration test that simulates health probes under sampling.
elena: TL;DR: misconfigured L7 audit sampler blocked k8s health probes -> nodes evicted -> cross-region prewarm and cost. Reverted, patching rules to mirror.
compliance: Sorry about the generator change; adding a unit test and marker to prevent DENY default on health endpoints.
derek: thanks all :thumbsup:
